_comment: Editor layout for the model-free (Tikhonov) DEER model (DeerTikhonovModel). Compute stays in deer.py; this JSON is user-editable.

sections.title: Regularisation

sections.label: Auto-α
sections.description: How alpha is chosen automatically: gcv = generalized cross-validation, lcurve = corner of the L-curve.
Tikhonov regularisation: smoothing strength alpha and how it is chosen.

sections.title: Modulation
sections.description: Modulation depth lambda and its settings: fraction of spins excited by the pump pulse (0-1).

sections.title: Background

sections.label: Model
sections.description: Functional form of the intermolecular background: hom3d = homogeneous 3-D, exp = exponential, strexp = stretched exponential.
Intermolecular background decay (exp, stretched exp or homogeneous 3-D) divided out of the DEER signal; its decay rate/dimension is fitted.

sections.title: Distance grid
sections.description: Distance axis r (nm) on which P(r) is evaluated: range and number of points.
